title: Tailscale or a Traditional Site-to-Site VPN: Mesh Networking vs Classic Tunnels
excerpt: Tailscale builds a WireGuard-based mesh between devices with very little configuration. A traditional site-to-site VPN links whole networks through gateways. Here is when each makes sense.
verdict: Tailscale is much faster and simpler for small and mid-sized teams spread across locations and home offices. A traditional site-to-site VPN still makes sense for larger organisations that need precise, centrally controlled routing and firewalling between networks.
